data.gender_notes: Belita is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek 'belos' meaning beautiful and 'ita' meaning little one. This name was borne by several saints and is derived from the Greek word for beauty. The name Belita carries the meaning “Beautiful little one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Belita usually hope their child will grow to embody beautiful little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name representing the beauty and grace of the divine.
data.etymology: Belita belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beautiful little one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Belita total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
